name: Floating Button/CTA – Easy to use
author: Trident Technolabs

sections.description:
Floating Button / CTA allows you to add a floating button that appears on all pages of your website. When
clicked, the main button reveals multiple sub-buttons with icons, links, and tooltips.

Features:

  • Fully customizable main button (icon, color, size, tooltip)
  • Add multiple sub-buttons (each with its own icon, color, link, tooltip)
  • Position the button anywhere on the screen (bottom-right, bottom-left, etc.)
  • Multiple button sets (only one displays at a time)
  • Lightweight and responsive design

Usage

  1. Click Add New Floating Button / CTA in the admin.
  2. Set a title (for reference, not displayed on the site).
  3. Configure the Main Button:
    • Choose an icon or upload a custom one
    • Set button position
    • Pick background and icon color
    • Add tooltip text
  4. Add Sub Buttons if needed:
    • Set icon or upload a custom icon
    • Set Link URL
    • Pick colors and tooltip text
  5. Publish your floating button.
  6. Visit any page on our site. Click the main button to reveal the sub-buttons.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the floating-button-cta folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Floating Button / CTA → Add New to create your first floating button.
  4. Configure your main button and optional sub-buttons.
  5. Publish your button -it will automatically appear on all pages.
sections.faq:
Can I have multiple floating buttons?

Yes, you can create multiple buttons, but only one set is displayed at a time.

Can I change the position of the button?

Yes, you can select left or right position from the main button settings.

Are the buttons responsive on mobile?

Yes, the floating button and sub-buttons work on desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
